rows.title: Indian AI Firm Seeks Up to $3B in Debt to Buy Nvidia Rubin Chips 🇮🇳 #Shorts #AI #Nvidia
rows.description:
An Indian AI company wants to borrow up to $3 billion, just to buy Nvidia chips. 🇮🇳💸

On October 30, 2026, Bloomberg reported that AM Intelligence, a Hyderabad-based AI infrastructure firm set up by the founders of renewable energy company Greenko, is seeking to raise up to $3 billion through bonds and bank loans. CNBC and Business Standard carried the report.

What the reports say:
• The money would fund the company's previously announced purchase of Nvidia's next-generation Rubin GPUs.
• AM Intelligence has announced firm orders for about 29,000 Rubin GPUs for AI factories in India and Malaysia (9,000 announced in August for Hyderabad, and 20,000 more announced on October 5, according to the company and CNBC).
• According to Bloomberg's sources, talks are at an early stage and terms could change.
• The firm also expects about $300 million in advance payments from potential customers (offtakers), the report said.
• A representative for AM Intelligence declined to comment to Bloomberg; it did not respond to CNBC.
